REPO_PURPOSE: ERPNext v16 on Frappe Cloud for MiSalud procurement, stock, assets, Purchase Orders, receipts, invoices, payments, and event planning. ERPNext supports procurement and inventory while Operis remains the CLIA-facing quality system of record.
REPO_LAYOUT: README.md gives the repo map. operations/erp/ contains stage roadmap and operational boundaries, compliance/ contains the Operis and SOP boundary, procurement/ contains operator and migration docs, procurement/migration/ contains runbooks and snapshots, .scripts/ contains ERPNext, Google Sheets, and migration automation, and docs/archive/ contains superseded docs that should not drive current work.
REPO_LOCAL_CONVENTIONS: Run automation from .scripts/. Credentials are loaded from .claude/ local files and must not be printed. ERPNext v1 wave work follows procurement/migration/RUNBOOK.md. Archived Gen 1 and Gen 2 docs are historical only. Operis owns CLIA-facing quality evidence; ERPNext owns procurement, inventory, assets, receipts, payments, warehouse movement, and event planning.
DEFAULT_COMMANDS:
- Script tests: `cd .scripts && npm test`
- Wave diff preflight: `cd .scripts && npm run erpnext:wave-diff`
- Verify live ERPNext parity only with approval: `cd .scripts && npm run erpnext:v1-verify`
- Snapshot live sheet only with approval: `python3 .scripts/fetch-live-sheet.py`
EXTERNAL_WRITE_OPERATIONS: ERPNext/Frappe Cloud creates, updates, deletes, resets, verifies with writes, workflow changes, PO/receipt/invoice/payment writes, stock entries, asset writes, Event Plan writes, Google Sheets snapshot or sync operations, Gmail sends, MCP server writes, Frappe deploys, backups, or rclone operations.
PRODUCTION_DATA_PATH_RULE: The live ERPNext instance is https://misalud.v.frappe.cloud. Treat ERPNext as production unless a task explicitly proves otherwise. Do not run write, reset, sync, migration, asset, BOM, PO, receipt, invoice, payment, event-plan, deploy, or backup commands without explicit approval.
CONFIG_CHANGE_RULE: Do not change ERPNext site URL, Frappe credentials, Google Sheets credentials, MCP server config, workflow names, PO autoname behavior, warehouse names, or Operis reference behavior without reading the current runbook and getting explicit approval.
PERMISSION_BOUNDARY_RULE: Destructive or outward-facing commands require explicit approval. Never add blanket shell permissions, broad remote automation, new CI, deploy keys, mirrors, or repo-read integrations without security review.
DEFAULT_READ_SCOPE: `README.md`, `procurement/migration/RUNBOOK.md`, `procurement/ERP-OPERATOR-MANUAL.md`, `operations/erp/`, `compliance/`, `.scripts/` source and tests excluding credentials and generated dependencies
EXCLUDED_PATHS: `.claude/.env.local`, `.claude/.gmail-token.json`, `.claude/google_sheets_token.json`, `procurement/migration/*.xlsx`, `.scripts/node_modules/`, `node_modules/`, `.mcp/`, `*.key`, `*.pem`, `sites/`, `bench/`, `logs/`, `*.log`, `.env`, `.env.*`, `docs/archive/` unless historical context is explicitly needed
